Select your file and follow the prompts to export
Share the exported .txt file with WhatsApp Wrapped
androidSteps: Open WhatsApp and long-press on the chat you want to export

info.title: Handle large exports on a computer
info.description: WhatsAnalyze processes everything locally in your browser, so huge TXT or ZIP exports can slow down phones. For smoother processing, send the exported file to your computer first and run the analysis there.

wrappedAboutPoints:
We are a group of friends with a shared passion for technology and curiosity about human communication. After years of intense WhatsApp usage, we wanted to understand how our conversations and relationships changed over time.

As computer scientists we wanted more than raw statistics—we wanted a tool that unites privacy and curiosity. That idea became WhatsAnalyze: a fully local, privacy-first solution that delivers meaningful insights without sharing personal information.

A tool by users, for users—transparent, secure, and crafted with care.
